correctness.rationale: The exact configuration identity B=M-sum(d_ij I_ij)+m I_all follows from exhaustive graph cycle types. Its disjoint case correction yields the complete joint pgf, and differentiating finite Bernoulli mixtures gives the covariance. Descartes plus Q(0)>0,Q(1)<0,Q(infinity)>0 proves exactly one zero in (0,1). Hypergeometric conditioning, two Pascal differences and the cubic identity prove the all-size concavity boundary; logarithmic inversion gives the equal-arm asymptotic. Independent standard-library checker enumerated 8640 subgraphs on ten theta graphs and passed 163 exact comparisons. The finite checks are supplemental, not the proof.
